name_reason: Name follows the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=battle core table, descriptor=walk_anim_y_scroll_rows). The descriptor accurately reflects both the role (cumulative Y/row scroll counter for the 6-frame field walk-step slide) and the data shape (a scalar row counter, not a table/flag/pointer). No Ghidra address residue in the name (the trailing token is 'rows', the semantic unit, not the hex 0x53b0b). Verified writers fd2_walk_step_down/up and reader fd2_composite_battle_tile_map all match this naming.
purpose: Cumulative row-scroll counter (signed int, BSS zero-init) for the smooth 6-frame field walk-step vertical slide; consumed only by the extra-wide parallax-chapter background composite path.
logic_summary: Lifecycle is entirely within a single walk step. fd2_walk_step_down clears it to 0 before the 6-frame slide loop and adds the per-frame window-scroll flag (0 or +1) each frame; fd2_walk_step_up seeds it to 6 (or 0 when view_window_origin_y==0) and adds the per-frame delta (-1 or 0) each frame. Both reset it to 0 at step end, so its resting value is 0. fd2_composite_battle_tile_map reads it for parallax chapters 0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B only: signed-divides by 3 (CDQ via SAR EDX,0x1f + IDIV ESI=3 @0x1206e), multiplies by the row stride (0x1ce or 0x198), and adds that into the static-background source offset to produce smooth sub-row vertical parallax during the slide.
element_semantics: Single scalar: cumulative window/row scroll count for the in-progress vertical walk step. Read signed and divided by 3 to yield the parallax background row shift. Writers keep the live value in [0,6]; it is never negative at the read site (the signed typing reflects the IDIV read idiom, not the value range).
comment_original_issue: Source comment was accurate and detailed but said fd2_walk_step_up 'seeds it to 6' without the conditional (it actually seeds 6 only when view_window_origin_y != 0, else 0), and did not explain why a row counter is typed signed (the read uses IDIV though the value stays in [0,6]).
notes: Three-source verified. (A) read_memory @0x53b0b = 64 bytes of 0x00 -> BSS runtime var, not a const table. (B) xrefs_to: READ from fd2_composite_battle_tile_map @0x12064; WRITE/READ_WRITE from fd2_walk_step_down (0x12ee8/0x12f8e/0x12ffe) and fd2_walk_step_up (0x131cc/0x131d8/0x132a0) -> has game-side writers, so is_const=false. (C) disasm @0x12064 confirms signed read: MOV EAX,[0x53b0b]; MOV EDX,EAX; SAR EDX,0x1f; IDIV ESI (ESI=3 set @0x1205f); IMUL EAX,EBX; ADD EAX,EDI. Ghidra plate already accurate (notes conditional seed + [0,6] range), left unchanged. Only the source comment block (one symbol) was edited via Edit; no logic/type/decl touched.
